validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE confirmed at high tier. This is a real, FERC-certificated interstate pipeline: Driftwood Pipeline LLC applied jointly with Driftwood LNG LLC on March 31, 2017 (Docket Nos. CP17-117-000/CP17-118-000); FERC issued the certificate order 167 FERC P61,054 (Apr. 18, 2019) and its companion Final EIS (FERC/FEIS-0284F, Jan. 2019), both of which describe a 96-mile, 48/42/36-inch mainline plus a 3.4-mile, 30-inch lateral from near Ville Platte, LA to the LNG facility near Carlyss, LA. The project has been under active construction since April 2022 per FERC's own 2025 Federal Register extension notice and Tellurian's own 2022 SEC 8-K (which names 'Driftwood Pipeline' directly and states a limited notice to proceed was issued to Bechtel in April 2022). Independently corroborated by the EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (which carries a 'Driftwood LNG Pipeline' row) and by Woodside's own April 2025 FID announcement, which explicitly breaks out pipeline scope/cost. No basis whatsoever for an existence or GEM-only-entity concern.
